package.name: ByeTunes
package.shortDescription: Downloads, synced lyrics, motion artwork, and library tools for Apple Music.

descriptionlist.description: ByeTunes expands Apple Music with music downloads, timed lyrics, animated artwork, playlist tools, library pinning, and interface controls. Built for iOS 15 and iOS 16.

DOWNLOADS & IMPORTS — Add download buttons to songs, albums, and playlists, then manage transfers in a queue with pause, resume, cancel, retry, and skip-already-owned controls. Choose FLAC, MP3, or FLAC with MP3 fallback. Import audio files, folders, and M3U playlists, or match Spotify and Deezer links to Apple Music. Playlist links can also create playlists in your library.

LYRICS — Fetch timed lyrics for songs or your library, edit them, find them manually, and adjust their timing. Use the free LRCLIB source or Musixmatch with your own token. Lyrics can open automatically in Now Playing. On supported devices with iOS 16.2 or later, ByeTunes can expose Apple Music Sing's vocal slider.

MOTION ARTWORK — Bring animated album covers to Now Playing. Choose the standard square animation or the immersive iOS 26 style with tall artwork and album-matched color. Artwork pauses in Low Power Mode.

LIBRARY & PLAYLISTS — Pin up to six favorite artists, albums, and playlists at the top of your Library. Create smart playlists, keep Loved, Most Played, Recently Played, and Top Rated playlists in sync, fetch playlist metadata and lyrics, import local music, show star ratings, and use library cleanup and sort-order repair tools.
MAKE MUSIC YOURS — Reorder and choose Music's tabs, add Downloads, filter search categories, set a default search tab, and follow download or metadata progress with the status banner.

PLATFORM NOTES — Animated artwork, downloads, and the main interface tools support iOS 15 and iOS 16. Pinning includes iOS 16-specific Library handling. Some other library database tools have less iOS 16 verification. Timed lyrics use different Music integrations on iOS 15 and 16; iOS 15 arm64e devices do not use the timed-lyrics hook. Apple Music Sing requires iOS 16.2+ and compatible hardware.

changelog.change: Downloads and imports: Search and page download buttons, queue, Spotify and Deezer link import, local import, library-wide metadata and lyrics.
Lyrics: LRCLIB and Musixmatch, word-by-word lyrics, manual lyrics search, editor and timing control, Apple Music Sing on iOS 16.2+.
Now Playing: animated artwork (standard and iOS 26 style) and a love button.
Library: pins, Loved and smart playlists, duplicate finder, tab manager and search filters.
Requires iOS 15 or iOS 16 on a rootless jailbreak.
